Chapter 1206 - 21 Killer Move ’Fierce Sun Fall’ (Seeking Subscription)_2

Chapter 1206: Chapter 21 Killer Move ’Fierce Sun Fall’ (Seeking Subscription)_2

A cold voice echoed through the void.

In the distance stood a towering figure, its skin covered in purple scales, none other than Venerate Fu Dang of Da Fu Ancient Country.

Among the twelve Peak Venerable sent by Da Fu Ancient Country, the strongest was Fu Xu Venerate, one of the most powerful Venerables in the history of the six ancient countries, having mastered a supreme inheritance.

Below Fu Xu Venerate were four top-tier Peak Venerables, and Venerate Fu Dang was at the third level among them.

"Hahaha, Fu Dang, who do you think you are? A top-tier Peak Venerable? Or Fu Xu Venerate?" Red Lotus Venerable mocked.

At the same time, stalling for time.

"Dealing with you is enough."

Venerate Fu Dang’s gaze was icy, and he swung his right hand, slashing towards Red Lotus Venerable from afar.

Red Lotus Venerable felt a great threat, and without a trace of contempt, immediately activated a defensive killing move. Clusters of Red Lotus flames began to boil, rotating around him.

Hiss hiss hiss~

The next moment.

The Protective Red Lotus of Red Lotus Venerable began to collapse, rapidly dissipating under a single attack from Venerate Fu Dang.

"So strong?"

Red Lotus Venerable felt the pressure. With just one exchange, half of his Protective Red Lotus had already crumbled, making him doubt whether he could hold out until Lin Yuan arrived.

"No matter what? This core Celestial Pillar must be defended."

Red Lotus Venerable gritted his teeth inside. The core Celestial Pillar was crucial to the ownership of this precious land. Perhaps the Fierce Sun Ancient Country needed just one more core Celestial Pillar to claim this treasure?

"Break!"

Venerate Fu Dang continued to attack, with each strike shattering a portion of Red Lotus Venerable’s Protective Red Lotus, but soon more Red Lotuses would coalesce.

"This Red Lotus is risking everything against me."

Venerate Fu Dang clearly understood that Red Lotus Venerable’s rapid coalescing of the dissipated Protective Red Lotus could not come without a price.

"So what if you’re risking everything?"

Venerate Fu Dang’s eyes were filled with purple, the power of each strike rapidly increasing.

Originally, one strike could collapse half of Red Lotus Venerable’s Protective Red Lotus; now it was shattering half or even the majority.

"Can’t hold on much longer."

Red Lotus Venerable sighed inwardly. In terms of strength, he was no match for Venerate Fu Dang.

Now, to protect the core Celestial Pillar behind him, it was as if he was standing as a target for Venerate Fu Dang’s attacks.

Under such circumstances, holding out until now was already remarkable.

"Once Venerate Fu Dang’s strike completely obliterates my Protective Red Lotus, it will mean the fall of my primary battle form."

Red Lotus Venerable thought to himself.

In a normal confrontation, he would naturally have the confidence to retreat unharmed from Venerate Fu Dang’s hands.

But now it wasn’t a normal fight; Red Lotus Venerable was taking blows unilaterally, refusing to retreat.

"Die now!" Venerate Fu Dang’s aura burst, purple energy swirling around him, preparing to unleash a shocking strike.

Just at this moment—

Time and space in the distance subtly warped, and a figure silently emerged.

"Galaxy Venerate is here?"

Red Lotus Venerable’s heart leapt with joy.

"Galaxy Venerate?"

Venerate Fu Dang’s heart skipped a beat.

He had heard of Galaxy Venerate’s reputation, who had incapacitated one of Spirit Prison Venerable’s Spirit Prisons, possessing the strength of a top-tier Peak Venerable.

"Even if Galaxy Venerate is here, you must still die."

Venerate Fu Dang was truly furious. If Red Lotus Venerable hadn’t fought death-defyingly, he might have already taken the core Celestial Pillar.

"Hm?"

Lin Yuan had just arrived nearby and saw Venerate Fu Dang pressing Red Lotus Venerable hard.

Red Lotus Venerable seemed like a lone boat on the verge of capsizing under Venerate Fu Dang’s attack.

Whoosh.

The Divine Skills world operated, and the external universe instantly spread, turning a billion miles area into his domain in an instant.

Venerate Fu Dang was quickly suppressed by the vast external universe, the purple world swirling around him continuously shrinking.

"This?"

Venerate Fu Dang’s pupils contracted; at this moment, he completely lost control over the surrounding space-time.

"Galaxy Venerate’s domain suppression is so powerful?" Venerate Fu Dang was utterly panicked.

Da Ling Ancient Country did circulate some intelligence on Lin Yuan, mentioning that this Galaxy Venerate had strong domain suppression techniques.

But Venerate Fu Dang never imagined it would be this strong, suppressing him instantly upon arrival.

"Since you’ve arrived, Galaxy Venerate, my Da Fu Ancient Country will cede this core Celestial Pillar."

Venerate Fu Dang immediately shouted loudly.

At this moment, he felt unprecedented pressure from Lin Yuan, even among the top four Peak Venerables of Da Fu Ancient Country, only two could exert such pressure on him.

You must understand, the Da Fu Ancient Country occupies the most first-class treasure lands, enjoying the best resources among the six ancient countries. In terms of strength, Da Fu’s power surpasses the other five.

Therefore, upon assessing the current situation, Fu Dang Venerate had only one thought in mind, which was—

To retreat immediately.

Swish.

Before Fu Dang Venerate could finish his words, he was already urging the Purple Intent World, fleeing into the distance.

Under the cosmic suppression of Lin Yuan, Fu Dang Venerate couldn’t engage in void traversal.

"Trying to leave?"

Lin Yuan glanced afar and immediately discerned Venerate Lin Fudang’s intentions.

"Spirit Prison could leave because killing him was too bothersome, but as for you?"

Lin Yuan’s gaze fell upon the Purple Intent World, and he thought to himself, "Perfect opportunity to test my newly comprehended killer move."

In a flash.

High above the external universe, rounds of Fierce Suns began to coalesce.

These Fierce Suns levitated slowly, and one suddenly began to plummet towards the escaping Purple Intent World.

As the first Fierce Sun fell, the second, third, and fourth followed suit.

This killer move is named—Fierce Sun Fall, one of the most potent moves Lin Yuan has comprehended, second only to detonating the external universe.

Detonating the external universe is undoubtedly terrifying in power, but it briefly weakens Lin Yuan afterward. By contrast, ’Fierce Sun Fall’ lacks such a risk, though slightly less powerful, it excels in persistence.

Boom!

Boom!

Boom Boom Boom!!!

When the first Fierce Sun struck Fu Dang Venerate, this Peak Venerable could barely hold on.

But by the time the two hundredth, three hundredth, and fourth hundredth Fierce Suns had struck, Fu Dang Venerate’s surrounding Purple Intent World rapidly collapsed.

"Galaxy Venerate!"

Fu Dang Venerate suddenly turned, fixing a fierce gaze on Lin Yuan before his body and soul were completely obliterated by the two thousandth, three thousandth falling Fierce Suns.

"Only held until the three thousandth round?"

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly; theoretically, this killer move could unleash a total of thirty-three thousand four hundred sixty-three Fierce Suns.

"Late arrival."

Having resolved Fu Dang Venerate, Lin Yuan gathered his relics and approached Fu Dang Venerate, speaking up.

"Not late."

Red Lotus Venerate appeared a bit dazed.

He had struggled immensely under Fu Dang Venerate’s attack, yet Fu Dang Venerate couldn’t endure as long before Galaxy Venerate.

Actually, it wasn’t about enduring; Fu Dang Venerate hadn’t considered endurance at all. He intended to flee right away but couldn’t.

"Venerate, you refine the Core Pillar first."

Red Lotus Venerate immediately stepped aside, with the Core Pillar behind him.

"Alright."

Lin Yuan didn’t refuse; this was the main task.

...

Independent space.

Red Flame Venerate looked at Lin Yuan in surprise: "Did you kill Fu Dang Venerate?"

Fu Dang Venerate, close to the level of a top Peak Venerable, could preserve himself even against top Peak Venerables unless determined to fight to the finish.

"Comprehended a killer move, somewhat restrained him."

Lin Yuan explained.

Simply put, the killer move ’Fierce Sun Fall’ restrains any Venerate below top Peak Venerable.

Unless one can completely resist round after round of falling Fierce Suns, no Peak Venerate can withstand three-four thousand rounds.

Even top Peak Venerables must allocate some focus to resist three-four thousand rounds of falling Fierce Suns.

"Restrain?"

Red Flame Venerate gazed deeply at Lin Yuan; as a Peak Venerate, his methods and abilities were nearly perfect, almost immune to restraint.

...

Next.

Lin Yuan continued to contest for core pillars within the treasure lands, amidst clashes with powerhouses from other ancient nations. Galaxy Venerate’s renown spread thoroughly.

On this day.

Within the independent space of Fierce Sun Country’s capital.

Red Flame Venerate suddenly looked at the other eleven Peak Venerables, a smile appearing on his face.

"Everyone."

Red Flame Venerate smiled and said, "It’s been explored how to use and absorb the golden mists the treasure lands nurture."
